rules.tokenizer: tokenizer.json of K3.25-v1 snapshot 0490d2f7 (both engines use this vocabulary); encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
rules.text_normalization: PG-19 books: bytes decoded as UTF-8, CRLF -> LF. vLLM sources: decoded as UTF-8 (files that fail are excluded), otherwise verbatim.
rules.prose_front_matter_skip: drop the first 16384 characters, then everything up to and including the next blank line (first '\n\n' at or after that offset), then any further leading newlines; the document starts at the next character.
rules.pg19_book_roles: books in pg19/SELECTION.json 'picked' order (seed 70901 there): 1st-3rd -> Q2 prose windows; 4th -> Block T prose context; 5th -> Block T reasoning context (8K).
rules.code_eligible_files: .py files under vllm/ in image ea0430aa whose first 5 lines contain 'SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0' and whose size is >= 2048 bytes; sorted by relative path; shuffled with random.Random(261001).shuffle.
rules.code_documents: documents are built by walking the shuffled list once, without reuse: each document appends files ('# ===== file: <relative path> =====\n' + file text, newline-terminated, + '\n'; each file keeps its own license/header lines) until its tokenization reaches the needed length. Documents 0-2 -> Q2 code windows (need 131,072 tokens); document 3 -> Block T code context (need 131,072); document 4 -> Block T JSON context (need 8,192). Code front-matter skip: none (0 characters).
rules.q2_windows: tokens = first L ids of the whole document's tokenization (raw text, no chat template, no BOS), L in 32,768 / 65,536 / 131,072, so the shorter windows of one document are prefixes of the longer; rows = the last 4,096 row indices L-4,096 .. L-1, where row p is the position whose prediction of token p is scored (it has seen tokens 0..p-1).
rules.chat_template: checkpoint chat_template.jinja (byte-identical to vLLM's glm53-zai-a5b45eb.jinja) renders one user message as TEMPLATE_PREFIX + content + TEMPLATE_SUFFIX; build verifies this with jinja2. The template has no thinking switch: CuteAFD renders thinking-off as an extra '</think>' (+1 token); vLLM renders the same text for on and off (its glm47 parser then streams the reasoning as content). Recorded prompt_tokens are for the template text including the nonce line.
rules.T_prompt_shape: user message = nonce line + '\n' + context_frame(context prefix, task). The context prefix is cut at a token boundary of the context document's own tokenization (character offset of the k-th token) and stripped of trailing whitespace, k searched so that the full templated prompt with the nonce line is exactly the target length (1,024 / 8,192 / 32,768 / 131,072); if no k gives an exact count, the character cut is moved character by character outward from the binary-search cut (within +-64 tokens), trying at each position the stripped cut and then the raw cut (trailing whitespace kept), and the nearest exact cut is taken (later cut first); any residual deviation is recorded per cell.
rules.T_contexts: prose -> PG-19 book 4; code -> code document 3; reasoning -> PG-19 book 5; json -> code document 4. One fixed context per content type; prompts differ only in the task and in where the cut falls.
rules.T_lengths: prose and code at 1K/8K/32K/128K; reasoning and json at 1K and 8K only (protocol).
rules.T_prose_items: LongBench-Write items with length >= 1,000 words, excluding the 4 Block L prose items, sorted by file index; random.Random(261002).shuffle; first 4.
rules.T_code_items: HumanEval+ task_ids sorted by number, random.Random(261003).shuffle, first 2 whose bare prompt fits 896 tokens; MBPP+ task_ids sorted, random.Random(261004).shuffle, first 2 that fit (MBPP prompt + test_list[0]). Prompt indices: HumanEval 0,1 then MBPP 2,3.
rules.math_items: MATH-500 level-5 items sorted by unique_id, random.Random(261005).shuffle; walk the list keeping items whose reference solution's last \boxed answer is_equiv() its `answer` (checkers/math_check.py) and whose bare prompt fits 896 tokens; first 4 -> Block T, next 4 -> Block L.
rules.json_items: authored/json_task.json: Block T variants_T (n = 40); Block L themes with n from variants_L_rule.
rules.L_prose_items: LongBench-Write items sorted by required length descending, ties by file index ascending; first 4.
rules.L_code_items: the 4 authored projects in prompts/L/code (minicalc, kvstore, graphkit, csvreport), SPEC.md in the L_code wrapper; hidden tests in each tests/ directory.
rules.L_prompt_shape: user message = nonce line + '\n' + task (no context).
rules.thinking: on for reasoning (chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=true), off for prose, code, json.
rules.nonce: see authored/wrappers.json nonce_rule; NONCE_GROUPS in prompts/nonce_groups.json.

L_json.theme: a self-storage and moving supplies shop
